rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when the employer is also the person you work for or report to.

example.english: My employer asked me to come to work early today.
example.traditional: 我個老闆今日叫我早啲返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 giu3 ngo5 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose and precise term, especially when referring to an employer as a person or organisation.

example.english: The employer must provide employees with a safe working environment.
example.traditional: 僱主必須為員工提供安全嘅工作環境。
example.jyutping: gu3 zyu2 bit1 seoi1 wai6 jyun4 gung1 tai4 gung1 on1 cyun4 ge3 gung1 zok3 waan4 ging2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when identifying the employer specifically as the person who pays the wages.

example.english: The employer is always late paying us; how can we pay the rent?
example.traditional: 出糧嗰個成日遲出糧，我哋點交租呀？
example.jyutping: ceot1 loeng4 go2 go3 seng4 jat6 ci4 ceot1 loeng4 ngo5 dei6 dim2 gaau1 zou1 aa3
